description.value: Pizza Cavern is a compact takeout-focused pizza shop in Duncan, BC, serving a broad menu of specialty and build-your-own pizzas, baked subs, wraps, and calzones. The kitchen leans into variety — from a Birria pulled pork pizza to a Greek and a Buffalo Chicken option — making it a practical mid-ride fuel stop for cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley. Gluten-free crust and several vegetarian builds are available for riders with dietary needs.
